en.learnText: For dense vocabulary targets, inspect BPM or DVLM. For realized-path credit, compare BTB and CAST. For text-only teachers, inspect GAD, ROPD, and OmniOPD. Read Rethinking alongside coverage-oriented methods.
en.compareEmpty: Select studies from the catalogue first.
en.clipboardFailed: Clipboard unavailable; copy the link below.
en.codeIntro: Status is based on official-source lookups, not independent reproduction. “Not located” does not mean no code exists. An announced release and an inaccessible code link are distinct from a verified public implementation. OPRD has public code with an implementation concern described below.
en.codeHelp: What does this code status mean?
en.scopeHelp: Core research uses student-generated states and explicitly different tokenizers.
en.codeAvailableHelp: An official public implementation was found. This does not mean the experiments were reproduced.
en.codeExperimentalHelp: An official implementation is public, but its API is experimental and may change.
en.codeMissingHelp: No official public implementation was located on the date below. This does not establish that code does not exist.
en.codeAnnouncedHelp: The authors announced a code release, but a public implementation was not located on the date below.
en.codeLinkedHelp: The paper links code, but access could not be verified. The linked service returned HTTP 401 during the recorded check.
en.codeConcern: The code is public, but the survey records a paper/implementation inconsistency.
en.readingDenseText: Compare byte-prefix mapping with a learned student-vocabulary head.
en.readingPathText: Compare synchronized text chunks and token-level credit assignment.
en.readingTextText: Compare adversarial feedback, rubrics, and semantic verification.
en.readingReliabilityText: Read Rethinking alongside methods that expand supervision coverage.
en.seoTitle: Cross-Tokenizer OPD Papers, Methods & Official Code
en.seoDescription: Explore cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation papers: author claims, methods, teacher–student pairs, official code, evidence and BibTeX. English, Japanese, Chinese and Korean.
en.socialAlt: Cross-Tokenizer OPD — research papers, methods, and official code across vocabularies.
